(1) ∵ $AE=AD$，∴ $\angle E=\angle ADE$ .
∵ $\angle ADE=\angle CDB$，∴ $\angle E=\angle CDB$ .
∵ $CD$ 平分 $\angle ACB$，∴ $\angle ACE=\angle BCD$，∴ $\triangle CEA\sim\triangle CDB$ .
(2) ∵ $CF\parallel AE$，∴ $\angle E=\angle DCF$ .
∵ $\angle DCF=\angle DCB+\angle BCF$，$\angle E=\angle CDF=\angle ACE+\angle CAD$，∴ $\angle BCF=\angle CAD$ .
又 $\angle F=\angle F$，∴ $\triangle CFB\sim\triangle AFC$，∴ $\frac{BF}{CF}=\frac{BC}{AC}$ .
由 $\triangle CEA\sim\triangle CDB$，∴ $\frac{BC}{AC}=\frac{BD}{AE}$；又 $AE=AD$，∴ $\frac{BC}{AC}=\frac{BD}{AD}$，∴ $\frac{BD}{AD}=\frac{BF}{CF}$ .
